scope: Theorem 1.1 (Nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality) of the manuscript “The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-nonmaximal-anti-de-Sitter-Penrose-Inequality-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e2b9ba2768918dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 4-5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
